title: One session, end to end
notes: Contract A (REV3). The five-chapter walkthrough teaches all twelve flagship pillars inside one continuous engineering session. Stage schematics describe documented v0.24.0 behaviour; whether a chapter may show a Verified Recording badge lives in proofs.manifest.json — never here. Every command pill links the capability that owns it.

nodes.title: Keep your CLIs. Add a living brain.
nodes.lede: Axym wraps the agent CLIs already on your machine — Claude, Codex, OpenCode and more — with zero static API keys. Behind them, a living repo brain keeps context warm and /po turns a fuzzy request into a scoped decision before any code moves.

nodes.label: 01 · CLIs & Repo Brain

nodes.title: Run agents in parallel without collisions.
nodes.lede: /runs gives every agent its own linked git worktree with live tmux, zellij or wezterm panes, so events and staged files never mix. A Council cross-check reviews the author's work, and when a provider hits its quota the run parks until reset instead of dying.

nodes.label: 02 · Worktrees & Mux

nodes.title: Firewall tools, stop hangs, control spend.
nodes.lede: The local MCP firewall admits tools by capability, taints untrusted output and keeps a full audit trail. Calm-UX classifies a hang, drains the orphan and arms the circuit breaker, while LinUCB cost routing picks the provider your budget agrees with — and speculative shadow evidence gathers proof while the review gate waits.

stage.summary: A poisoned MCP response is denied and tainted before it reaches the model, a stall is classified instead of retried forever, and the cost router records why it picked the cheaper provider.

nodes.title: Ship only what passes independent proof.
nodes.lede: Adversarial QA, AIDE root-cause diagnosis and axym fitness gate the change before /ship offers it; the Result Ledger is hash-chained and a cassette replay proves the run reproduces. Shipping stays a separate human decision — apply is explicit and reversible.
